Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Italy

facts.c: Italy's Foreign Ministry says some of its employees were involved in illicitly issuing work visas to non-EU citizens, and it is cooperating with investigators
facts.q: corrupt activities carried out by some employees involved in the illicit issuance of work visas, which were improperly granted to non-EU citizens
facts.note: Page date: the URL gives February 2025; the arrests it reports were on 19 February 2025 (N0072)

facts.c: The Foreign Ministry's inspections since 2023 have helped identify criminal networks in Italy that profit from Decreto Flussi visas and from fraudulent tourist visas
facts.q: identifying criminal networks in Italy that profit from the granting of visas under the so-called decreto flussi, as well as from the issuance of fraudulent tourist visas

facts.c: An investigation by the Rome Prosecutor's Office and the Guardia di Finanza led to a custody order against five people, including two former employees who served at an embassy abroad at the time
facts.q: led to the execution of a precautionary custody order against five individuals, including two former employees who were serving at an embassy abroad

facts.c: For the 2025 Decreto Flussi, 14,349 residence permits were being issued against 181,450 places (7.9%) by December 2025
facts.q: sono 14.349 i permessi di soggiorno in via di rilascio dalle prefetture su 181.450 quote stabilite dal governo per gli ingressi (7,9%)
facts.note: Data from Interior Ministry access-to-records requests, updated to 10 December 2025

facts.c: For the 2024 Decreto Flussi, 24,858 residence permits had been requested against 146,850 places (16.9%) by December 2025
facts.q: mentre per i flussi 2024 sono 24.858 su 146.850 quote fissate (16,9%)

facts.c: For the 2025 Decreto Flussi, applications for Bangladeshi workers had 7,153 negative outcomes (rejected, revoked, archived or withdrawn) out of 35,932 received
facts.q: provenienti dal Bangladesh che sono 7.153 per il 2025 (su 35.932 domande ricevute)

facts.c: For the 2024 Decreto Flussi, of 329,001 applications for Bangladeshi workers, 62,965 ended negatively, including about 20,000 archived and 22,000 withdrawn
facts.q: per il Bangladesh su 329.001 domande presentate sono state 62.965 le pratiche che hanno ricevuto un esito negativo (di cui 20.000 archiviate, insieme a 22.000

facts.c: Bangladesh alone accounted for about 50% of all negative outcomes in the 2024 Decreto Flussi
facts.q: il Bangladesh da solo copre circa il 50% degli esiti negativi totali riscontrati per il 2024

facts.c: For the 2024 Decreto Flussi, by December 2025, 19,503 nulla osta had been issued for Bangladeshis, 1,262 had obtained a permit, and 1,058 were still waiting to enter Italy
facts.q: sono stati 19.503 i nulla osta rilasciati a persone provenienti da quel paese e 1.262 i permessi di soggiorno ottenuti, mentre 1.058 persone sono in attesa

facts.c: 2024 Decreto Flussi, Bangladesh (to December 2025): 329,001 applications, 19,503 nulla osta, 2,313 visas issued, 129 visas requested and not issued, 422 refused, 41 revoked, 1,262 permits requested (5.1% of all permits)

2025 Decreto Flussi, Bangladesh (to December 2025): 35,932 applications, 2,407 nulla osta, 1,874 visas issued, 57 requested and not issued, 95 refused, 22 revoked, 1,038 permits requested (7.2% of all permits)
Applications from Sri Lanka, Pakistan, Bangladesh and Morocco fell sharply in 2025 compared with 2024, by between 51.5% and 88.6%
facts.q: una drastica riduzione delle domande pervenute nel 2025 rispetto al 2024, con cali che oscillano tra il –51,5% e il –88,6%

facts.c: In December 2025, 23,141 applications from the 2024 quota for the four 'at-risk' countries (Bangladesh, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Morocco) were still suspended, 16,272 at consulates and 6,869 in pre-checks at the Prefetture
facts.q: risultano sospese 23.141 domande - di cui 16272 nelle rappresentanze consolari e 6869

facts.c: Across all consulates, the average wait for a work visa to be issued was 17 days for the 2024 quota and 18 days for the 2025 quota (December 2025 data)
facts.q: si registra un tempo medio di attesa per il rilascio del visto di 17 giorni e per i flussi 2025 di 18 giorni

facts.c: Across all consulates, handling a work-visa application up to issue took 44 days on average for the 2024 quota
facts.q: I tempi aumentano se si guarda al tempo medio di trattazione della domanda fino al rilascio del visto: 44 giorni in media relativamente ai flussi 2024

facts.c: For visa applications presumed suspended under the extra checks, average processing in 2024 was far longer than normal: Dhaka 290 days, Islamabad 310, Colombo 115, Rabat 103
facts.q: risultano molto più elevati del tempo ordinario (es. Dhaka 290 giorni, Islamabad 310, Colombo 115, Rabat 103 nel 2024)
v: Dhaka visa processing for suspended files, 2024 (average)

facts.c: Testimonies say consulates now run their own checks on work-entry applications on top of those by the Prefetture, Questure and labour inspectorates, asking for documents and interviews and causing further delays
facts.q: Prefetture, dalle Questure e dagli Ispettorati del lavoro, con richieste di documenti e di colloqui, generando ulteriori ritardi

facts.c: For the four 'at-risk' countries including Bangladesh, waits in the procedure reach almost ten months
facts.q: tempi di attesa estremamente lunghi, che arrivano fino a quasi dieci mesi

facts.c: An employers' association says that for the 'at-risk' countries, seasonal workers' visas were issued about ten months late
facts.q: i visti per i lavoratori stagionali sono stati rilasciati con ritardi significativi, pari a circa dieci mesi

facts.c: Decree-Law 145/2024 removed the advance notice of refusal (preavviso di rigetto) for entry-visa procedures
facts.q: si stabilisce che il preavviso di rigetto della domanda non si applichi ai procedimenti per il rilascio dei visti di ingresso

facts.c: Without the advance notice, applicants are not told the reasons beforehand and lose the chance to add missing documents
facts.q: negando la possibilità di un'eventuale integrazione di documentazione mancante

facts.c: A labour-agency operator says this often forces applicants to spend thousands of euros on TAR appeals against revoked nulla osta or visas
facts.q: Spesso ciò costringe a sostenere migliaia di euro di spese per ricorsi al TAR volti ad annullare revoche di nulla osta o di visto

facts.c: The job-seeking permit (permesso per attesa occupazione) in this case needs written authorisation from the head of the SUI at the Prefettura
facts.q: è prevista la necessità di un’autorizzazione scritta da parte del responsabile dello Sportello Unico per l’Immigrazione presso la Prefettura

facts.c: The rules (a 2007 circular) allow a job-seeking permit when the employer, after the worker has entered Italy, no longer wants to hire him
facts.q: qualora il datore o la datrice di lavoro, dopo l’ingresso in Italia del cittadino o della cittadina non UE, non abbia più interesse alla sua assunzione

facts.c: Questure issued 886 job-seeking permits (attesa occupazione) in 2023, 835 in 2024 and 666 in 2025
facts.q: I titoli rilasciati dalle questure ammontano a 886 per il primo anno; 835 per il 2024; e 666 nel 2025.

facts.c: A help-desk worker reports a case where, after the employer failed to appear, no other employer could sign the contratto di soggiorno: only the employer who had called the worker could hire her for the permit
facts.q: l’unica persona che avrebbe potuto assumerla per permetterle di ottenere il permesso era colei che inizialmente l’aveva chiamata

facts.c: There is no public portal where a worker can check a nulla osta's authenticity by entering its file number
facts.q: non esiste un portale pubblico di verifica del nulla osta (es. inserendo il numero pratica)

facts.c: Official messages about the application often go only to the employer; the worker gets no copies or direct notices
facts.q: la comunicazione ufficiale delle pratiche è spesso indirizzata solo al datore di lavoro; il lavoratore non riceve copie o notifiche dirette

facts.c: By December 2025, 16,360 nulla osta had been issued on 32,016 applications to convert a seasonal permit into a non-seasonal work permit
facts.q: su 32.016 domande di conversione, sono stati rilasciati 16.360 nulla osta

facts.c: Across all countries, 133 people trained abroad (Article 23 route) entered Italy in 2024 and 401 in 2025
facts.q: Gli ingressi nel 2024 sono stati 133, mentre nel 2025 sono entrate 401 persone formate

facts.c: In 2025, 238 carers entered Italy on the out-of-quota care route, from 599 applications
facts.q: Nel 2025, hanno fatto ingresso in Italia 238 lavoratori e lavoratrici per l’assistenza alla persona a fronte di 599 domande

facts.c: By permits requested for the 2025 quota, India came first, followed by Egypt, Tunisia, Morocco, Albania and Bangladesh
facts.q: il numero maggiore di persone provengono dall’India, seguita dall’Egitto, dalla Tunisia, dal Marocco, dell’Albania e dal Bangladesh

facts.c: In May 2024, after receiving the nulla osta it took six to seven months to get a visa appointment
facts.q: after receiving the nulla osta it takes six to seven months to get an appointment for a visa

facts.c: A Naogaon worker paid Tk 13.5 lakh in May 2023 for his work permit and was still waiting a year later
facts.q: In May last year,’ Apu points out to AsiaNews, ‘I paid Tk 13.5 lakh to get the permit, but I am still waiting

facts.c: Victims reported scammers in Italy offering false clearances and local brokers taking money with promises to guarantee visa appointments
facts.q: scammers in Italy offer false clearances, while local brokers embezzle money by promising to guarantee visa appointments

facts.c: In May 2024 the passports of at least 100,000 applicants were being held by the Italian Embassy and VFS Global
facts.q: the passports of at least 100,000 applicants are being held by the Italian Embassy and VFS Global

facts.c: Applicants formed human chains in front of the Italian Embassy on 27 March and 22 April 2024
facts.q: formed a human chain in front of the Italian embassy on 27 March and 22 April

facts.c: Regulation (EU) 2026/464 designates Bangladesh, Colombia, Egypt and others as safe countries of origin at Union level
facts.q: The following third countries are designated as safe countries of origin at Union level: Bangladesh Colombia Egypt

facts.c: Six EU member states designated Bangladesh as a safe country of origin nationally, and the EU-wide recognition rate for Bangladeshi applicants was 4% in 2024
facts.q: six Member States currently designate Bangladesh as a safe country of origin at national level, and the Union-wide recognition rate for applicants from Bangladesh was 4 % in 2024

facts.c: The EU found that there is, in general, no persecution in Bangladesh within the meaning of EU asylum law
facts.q: There is, in general, no persecution in the country within the meaning of Article 9 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1347.

facts.c: The safe-country concept may be applied only where the applicant cannot show, in an individual assessment, why it does not apply to them
facts.q: Member States may apply the concept of safe country of origin only where the applicant cannot provide elements justifying why the concept of safe country of origin is not applicable

facts.c: Special attention is to be paid to applicants such as LGBTIQ persons, victims of gender-based violence, human rights defenders, religious minorities and journalists
facts.q: applicants who are in a specific situation in those countries, such as LGBTIQ persons, victims of gender-based violence, human rights defenders, religious minorities and journalists

facts.c: Regulation (EU) 2026/464, published in the Official Journal on 26 February 2026, entered into force the day after publication
facts.q: This Regulation shall enter into force on the day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union.

facts.c: The EU Asylum Procedure Regulation (EU) 2024/1348 applies from 12 June 2026
facts.q: In light of the application of Regulation (EU) 2024/1348 from 12 June 2026

facts.c: The EU safe-country list is added as Annex II to the Asylum Procedure Regulation (EU) 2024/1348
facts.q: the text set out in the Annex to this Regulation is added as Annex II to Regulation (EU) 2024/1348

facts.c: A visa refusal is communicated in a language the applicant understands or, failing that, in English, French, Spanish or Arabic
facts.q: shall be communicated to the person concerned in a language that he/she understands or, failing that, in English, French, Spanish or Arabic

facts.c: Refusals of family reunification or accompanying-family visas can be appealed to the ordinary court with no time limit
facts.q: Only in the case of refusals of visas for family reunification or accompanying family members, any appeals may be lodged with the competent ordinary court without any time limit.

facts.c: An appeal against a visa refusal must be notified directly to the Avvocatura dello Stato (State Legal Service)
facts.q: Any appeals shall be notified directly to the Avvocatura dello Stato (the State Legal Service).

facts.c: National visas are issued within 30 days for employment within the Decreto Flussi quotas, 30 days for family reunification and 120 days for self-employment
facts.q: (30 days for employment, within the quotas envisaged by the so-called Flows Decree, 30 days for family reunification and 120 days for self-employment)

facts.c: As a general rule a national visa is issued within 90 days of the application
facts.q: shall issue the visa within 90 days of the application

facts.c: The visa deadlines may not be met when checks, data or documents from foreign authorities are needed
facts.q: these terms may not be respected in the event that checks, verifications and collection of data, documents and evaluations by foreign authorities become necessary

facts.c: Schengen visa applications may be submitted no more than six months before the trip
facts.q: Noting that visa applications may be submitted no more than six months

facts.c: Schengen visa applications should as a rule be submitted no later than 15 calendar days before the trip
facts.q: as a rule, no later than 15 calendar days before the start of the intended travel

facts.c: A Schengen visa is decided within 15 days, extendable up to 45 days in specific cases
facts.q: 15 days that can be extended up to 45 days, in the cases provided for specifically

facts.c: Italian embassies and consulates always report forged documents used for a visa application to the Italian judicial authorities
facts.q: The counterfeiting of documents produced by foreign nationals to obtain an entry visa shall always be reported by the diplomatic-consular Representations to the Italian judicial authorities

facts.c: If a mission learns of facts that would have barred a visa already issued, it revokes or cancels the visa
facts.q: Should the diplomatic/consular Missions become aware of facts, situations and conditions that would have prevented the granting of an entry visa
